chapter: Forming the band in New York
title: Avery Parrish and Sammy Lowe learn to write
summary: Hawkins taught Parrish to arrange and showed Lowe his first lead sheet.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: That was, Avery came in before I gave you the extra names.
And was Avery doing any of the arrangements at that time?

Oh, yes. I showed, by the way, I showed Avery how to arrange. He did things like my first theme song when I called 'Swing Out.' was broadcasting. Avery composed that. He composed a few tunes in there, some I can't remember now, besides 'After Hours'. Anyway, he did a lot of writing for me also.

And (inaudible), I showed Sammy his first lead sheet. I showed him how to start off. And then, he used to bring it into me, the boys used to laugh at him. And, I said we gonna keep playing it until you get it right.
And then, Sam started going away from that and did a lot of writing.
